seo.title: HubGet – the app store for Windows
seo.description: One store for every app on Windows. HubGet safely installs, updates and uninstalls apps from official repositories – in one click, with no ads and no bundled extras.
seo.ogTitle: HubGet – the app store for Windows
seo.ogDescription: One store for every app on Windows. Safe, simple and fully under your control.

texty.t2: One store for every app on Windows.
texty.t3: HubGet is a modern app store for Windows 10 and 11. It brings together more than 25,000 apps from official repositories – install them in one click, without hunting for installers on the web, with no ads and no bundled extras.
texty.t20: Installing apps should be safe and simple.
texty.t22: Only the official repositories of package managers. Every installer is verified against its SHA-256 checksum before it runs.
texty.t24: One click instead of setup wizards. No “Next, Next, Finish”, no bundled extras and no ads.
texty.t26: Update and uninstall all your apps in one place – including the ones you installed earlier, some other way.
texty.t29: Every topic has its own page – pick what interests you.
texty.t31: An app store like on your phone: the catalog, ratings and reviews, updates, uninstall and background mode.
texty.t33: What works for real: WinGet, Chocolatey, Scoop and developer package managers with commands to copy.
texty.t35: What’s new in every version since the first public release, 0.1.0.
texty.t37: How HubGet stacks up against Ninite, UniGetUI, Chocolatey and Winstall.app.
texty.t39: Where HubGet is heading next and what’s already done.
texty.t41: SmartScreen, accounts, safety and other common questions.
texty.t51: The code is public, so it stays free. Your data stays on your computer while you manage, update and install apps.
texty.t53: Version {auto:version} · preview · free and open source · [what’s new](changelog.html)
